a1e44e6f1d57.speaker: Asa
a1e44e6f1d57.text: There's good dirt under all this moss. Who's been using it?

acba48946a3c.speaker: Asa
acba48946a3c.text: I can't go on... come back for me.

bbfa99a3a8b6.speaker: Asa
bbfa99a3a8b6.text: You're not from the village. Doesn't matter. Help me with this sack.

c1ec9e49018d.speaker: Bjarne
c1ec9e49018d.text: Thank you. I thought that was it.

10fbffecf4d7.speaker: Bjarne
10fbffecf4d7.text: I can't take much more of this.

d1969253b611.speaker: Bjarne
d1969253b611.text: Nothing gets to you without going through me.

96e028137023.speaker: Bjarne
96e028137023.text: I came to examine the old iron markers. Whatever protects the road has cracked. Steel will

a493a54c5148.speaker: Bjarne
a493a54c5148.text: We came to learn why this forest has become bewitched. First, we need shelter. Follow the

70d6b5d71c5c.speaker: Bjarne
70d6b5d71c5c.text: Stay near the stones. We can still get out of this together.

8e380ffa97a7.speaker: Bjarne
8e380ffa97a7.text: Where's the anvil? No, don't tell me. I'll find it.

28b3e35db35c.speaker: Bjarne
28b3e35db35c.text: Tell Sigrid I kept it lit.

2036e6375a75.speaker: Bjarne
2036e6375a75.text: You took your time. Mind the hammer.

8a4f5935addb.speaker: Bjarne
8a4f5935addb.text: I blazed the trees going in, a cut every twenty paces. Coming back, my marks were on the w

7b44fb41a6db.speaker: Eirik
7b44fb41a6db.text: Thank you. I thought that was it.

45a96e8c622c.speaker: Eirik
45a96e8c622c.text: I can't take much more of this.

c04da0bacbb6.speaker: Eirik
c04da0bacbb6.text: Nothing gets to you without going through me.

ecf931abe27e.speaker: Eirik
ecf931abe27e.text: I trust that she wants to get out of here alive. That is enough for tonight. But watch her

b0793a604c63.speaker: Eirik
b0793a604c63.text: My sister's farm is two valleys from here. Her dogs ran into these woods last month and ne

2be6d1c7fb78.speaker: Eirik
2be6d1c7fb78.text: Once, as a boy, with my sister. Spruce, moss, the quiet you get in old woods. Nothing in i

ee09dd20e0e2.speaker: Eirik
ee09dd20e0e2.text: Twenty winters in the shield wall at Granheim. I stopped counting the fights a long time a

4cc1b4c6dd1f.speaker: Eirik
4cc1b4c6dd1f.text: Wolves, probably. Perhaps a witch, perhaps a sick troll. It is usually less than the stori

49035598e0ba.speaker: Eirik
49035598e0ba.text: Eat something, even if you are not hungry. I have buried enough friends who thought they c

508dfc1d9aef.speaker: Eirik
508dfc1d9aef.text: Stay between me and the trees. If anything comes out of the dark, it meets my shield first

2f26f0679d18.speaker: Eirik
2f26f0679d18.text: Eat something. It is a long road, and the porridge is not getting any better.

2a01eb5d9ef5.speaker: Eirik
2a01eb5d9ef5.text: Go! I will hold them. Nobody gets left behind, not while I am standing.

b3f411f0c08b.speaker: Eirik
b3f411f0c08b.text: Before we set out? Gladly. Take this practice sword; it bruises, it doesn't cut. Hit the d

767a22ae60af.speaker: Eirik
767a22ae60af.text: Dry bread, unless you fancy a walk. There are berry bushes in the clearing west of the she

c28e92c08877.speaker: Eirik
c28e92c08877.text: Now that is a fine idea. Anything but this porridge. Here is a rod and a handful of grubs,

865f6003701b.speaker: Eirik
865f6003701b.text: We always need firewood. Take this hatchet; there are good trees on the slope north of the

3dae44864cb6.speaker: Eirik
3dae44864cb6.text: Breakfast! You may be the best person on this expedition. Keep the rod; there is bound to

58c732b675e8.speaker: Eirik
58c732b675e8.text: Hot food. You have just made three friends for life. Take these, in case the night is not

66a26e4cddf1.speaker: Eirik
66a26e4cddf1.text: That will keep us warm. Keep the hatchet.

aa06518f4d6a.speaker: Eirik
aa06518f4d6a.text: You'll do. Better than most I have trained, worse than you will be. Take these; you will w

204532e77379.speaker: Eirik
204532e77379.text: Dummy first, then me. Watch my shoulders: the blow is coming when they drop.

237db04c75f3.speaker: Eirik
237db04c75f3.text: Five berries from the clearing to the west, then the pot. My waterskin is in your pack.

7d57bc6e0d58.speaker: Eirik
7d57bc6e0d58.text: Six logs from the slope north of the road. Walk up to a tree and get chopping.

a06343cbeb7e.speaker: Eirik
a06343cbeb7e.text: Two fish from the lake. Hold attack to swing back, let go to cast, and strike when the flo

409a4177aa8b.speaker: Eirik
409a4177aa8b.text: Show me the wall. Then show me where it's weakest.

234d8569fee7.speaker: Eirik
234d8569fee7.text: Still got one more swing in me, then.

642add613889.speaker: Eirik
642add613889.text: Twenty winters, and it still hurts.

026f1f260873.speaker: Eirik
026f1f260873.text: Don't look at me like that. I was resting. ...Thank you.

ca4d6075a674.speaker: Eirik
ca4d6075a674.text: My knees are too old to run from a closing portal. Next time leave earlier.

1f29819f666c.speaker: Eirik
1f29819f666c.text: That many, and I'm still here. Don't tell the young ones. They'll want to try it.

42963c424b5a.speaker: Eirik
42963c424b5a.text: Twenty winters I've been telling that kind of story. First time it's been true.

96cb0594d562.speaker: Eirik
96cb0594d562.text: Took you long enough. How many are behind you?

bce3accf463e.speaker: Eirik
bce3accf463e.text: Stay behind my shield, if you can find it.

60556e38b6f5.speaker: Eirik
60556e38b6f5.text: Clean your blade. It's a bad habit to forget.

63fa83d0ac03.speaker: Eirik
63fa83d0ac03.text: Is that all? I was only warming up.

2cfa0e55e972.speaker: Eirik
2cfa0e55e972.text: A soldier's choice. It is old iron, but it holds an edge. Guard well and let them come to

0806b86eec93.speaker: Eirik
0806b86eec93.text: Eirik. Twenty winters in the shield wall at Granheim. I walk in front, I carry the heavy t

259bff6f5a51.speaker: Eirik
259bff6f5a51.text: Long reach, and it wants both hands. If you ever need a light instead, press L to swap the

e253fe508b50.speaker: Eirik
e253fe508b50.text: The axe. Good. It splits wolves and firewood alike, and it leaves you a hand free.

eece7650fb22.speaker: Eirik
eece7650fb22.text: Then we are after the same thing. We will find them.

e60cc7b39128.speaker: Eirik
e60cc7b39128.text: A bewitched forest. My grandmother called any forest that ate her goats bewitched.

ca4cbe04a50b.speaker: Eirik
ca4cbe04a50b.text: A whole day gone in a morning's walk. I don't like this, and I have liked very few things.

1d8417ed6712.speaker: Eirik
1d8417ed6712.text: And the kindling you cut this morning is dry in your pack. We only need stones.

7117ba9e1974.speaker: Eirik
7117ba9e1974.text: And there is only dry bread, unless someone fancies a walk. Ask me if you do.

1c84061a496c.speaker: Eirik
1c84061a496c.text: Down you go. Catch your breath; we go again when you're ready.

d50f787957ae.speaker: Eirik
d50f787957ae.text: Enough, enough! I yield. You'll do.

8778acb3c599.speaker: Eirik
8778acb3c599.text: Good. Now me. When I wind up, raise your guard just before the blow, or roll through it.

236c80028a4c.speaker: Eirik
236c80028a4c.text: I salted what was left of your fish, so we need fewer berries. Two handfuls will do.

421f24f8ee2b.speaker: Eirik
421f24f8ee2b.text: Is it past noon already? We have not been walking an hour.

1e77282ea3ce.speaker: Eirik
1e77282ea3ce.text: It is this place. At the tree line I had to think for my own sister's name. I did not like

b7949786e4d1.speaker: Eirik
b7949786e4d1.text: Nothing gets worse than this porridge.

3610b36553f1.speaker: Eirik
3610b36553f1.text: Sigrid. The sun is going down. It was morning.

4d163872b0ec.speaker: Eirik
4d163872b0ec.text: Steady now. It is a fine morning to walk into something stupid.

1fd66a7f37f5.speaker: Eirik
1fd66a7f37f5.text: That trout this morning. I keep thinking about that trout.

fdd9aacb46e5.speaker: Eirik
fdd9aacb46e5.text: Twenty years a soldier, and I have never seen the sun simply leave.

35cf24431724.speaker: Eirik
35cf24431724.text: Whoever you came for: we have not stopped looking. Remember that.

4fce6c3e4d95.speaker: Gunnar
4fce6c3e4d95.text: You've been frightening my deer. Least you can do is give me a roof.

baff5d14427f.speaker: Gunnar
baff5d14427f.text: I can't go on... come back for me.

4e8a945d6f2f.speaker: Gunnar
4e8a945d6f2f.text: Took you long enough. That boar's been lying on me since yesterday.

c76619189511.speaker: Hild
c76619189511.text: Whoever laid this hearth had never met a level. I'll stay.

668e374da7f3.speaker: Hild
668e374da7f3.text: I can't go on... come back for me.

42fc5176f1e2.speaker: Hild
42fc5176f1e2.text: Mind the coping. It's the only level thing for a mile.

8d07deaf4e3e.speaker: Ingrid
8d07deaf4e3e.text: Thank you. I thought that was it.

ed15b636c600.speaker: Ingrid
ed15b636c600.text: I can't take much more of this.

7b1ba29498df.speaker: Ingrid
7b1ba29498df.text: Nothing gets to you without going through me.

1c8f76456f8f.speaker: Ingrid
1c8f76456f8f.text: The plants are wrong. Roots that should sleep in this season are warm to the touch. Someth

b681b610162a.speaker: Ingrid
b681b610162a.text: We came to learn why this forest has become bewitched. First, we need shelter. Follow the

33c08208b361.speaker: Ingrid
33c08208b361.text: Stay near the stones. We can still get out of this together.

58a94203429e.speaker: Ingrid
58a94203429e.text: I kept saying the word so the forest couldn't take it. Fire. Fire. Fire. And then I saw yo

a746957e8f6d.speaker: Ingrid
a746957e8f6d.text: I can't... go on. I'll hide here. Come back for me.

18ca34a3c2a4.speaker: Ingrid
18ca34a3c2a4.text: It's you! I saw a light through the trees and thought the forest had finally taken my wits

cd9cdccb02ea.speaker: Ingrid
cd9cdccb02ea.text: I watched your fire for three nights from under a root. You should know two things. The ol

80dc0f32cc9d.speaker: Liv
80dc0f32cc9d.text: Thank you. I thought that was it.

dc8be3b09db6.speaker: Liv
dc8be3b09db6.text: I can't take much more of this.

b49ef4e8075b.speaker: Liv
b49ef4e8075b.text: Nothing gets to you without going through me.

8e4d98588b80.speaker: Liv
8e4d98588b80.text: There are old paths here, older than the villages. My teacher said the waystones connected

475a6b7d8d80.speaker: Liv
475a6b7d8d80.text: We came to learn why this forest has become bewitched. First, we need shelter. Follow the

78a80ac74fe4.speaker: Liv
78a80ac74fe4.text: The stones are answering you. Stay close. I will try to keep the passage open.

c31f49e71de1.speaker: Liv
c31f49e71de1.text: Your ward is a promise too. Did anyone tell you?

68c7bc7eddb7.speaker: Liv
68c7bc7eddb7.text: Write it down. Somebody has to write it down.

1541b0517f14.speaker: Liv
1541b0517f14.text: The stones broke along a line. A line! Do you understand what that means?

c9cd91fa9b2c.speaker: Notice Board
c9cd91fa9b2c.text: To whoever comes after: this hearth wants copper, and hands that can work it. Smelt ingots

a69d67c10a70.speaker: Runa
a69d67c10a70.text: Thank you. I thought that was it.

71421b87e14d.speaker: Runa
71421b87e14d.text: They're too close, I need room!

9ddfaf8a7306.speaker: Runa
9ddfaf8a7306.text: Nothing gets to you without going through me.

7dcdf070c8ed.speaker: Runa
7dcdf070c8ed.text: Deer, boar, wolf, all running west out of the trees, out here where they don't belong. Not

16b7baffeed3.speaker: Runa
16b7baffeed3.text: Poaching on the jarl's land. You learn to hit with the first arrow when the second one bri

6ce65a9922ba.speaker: Runa
6ce65a9922ba.text: Someone is paying. And I would rather know what is coming out of there than wait for it to

76c565135e42.speaker: Runa
76c565135e42.text: Troll tracks. Small ones, the moss kind. They never come this far down. Something is pushi

1074ba01f75e.speaker: Runa
1074ba01f75e.text: Walk where the moss is thick; it's quieter. Keep your back to the fire, never your face. A

eba413013aa1.speaker: Runa
eba413013aa1.text: I counted three wolves circling and one shape that was not a wolf. Keep your voice down. I

07aa6906d1c5.speaker: Runa
07aa6906d1c5.text: Tracks everywhere, all running the same way. Whatever they are fleeing, we are walking tow

f24d01247188.speaker: Runa
f24d01247188.text: Nice morning. That is usually how it starts.

8c705e2c6bd4.speaker: Runa
8c705e2c6bd4.text: I will take the ones on the stones. You just keep breathing.

7dcf8ab9db2b.speaker: Runa
7dcf8ab9db2b.text: Wolves! They are not hunting; something is driving them towards us. Protect the camp!

c12e96614ee4.speaker: Runa
c12e96614ee4.text: More of them, coming round the other side!

21df7a00a9af.speaker: Runa
21df7a00a9af.text: As it happens. There are blight boar on the grass north of the road, east of the camp, whi

eeb952b8fed5.speaker: Runa
eeb952b8fed5.text: Clean enough. Keep the bow; you've earned it, and I was tired of carrying it.

64ff1b055945.speaker: Runa
64ff1b055945.text: Two boar, on the grass north of the road, east of the camp. Hold the left button to draw.

786ca2a1ec9d.speaker: Runa
786ca2a1ec9d.text: This place can be found. Good. So can everything else, by the same road.

f64ff77036a6.speaker: Runa
f64ff77036a6.text: I know the way. Go on. I'll catch you up.

a9ab3bf298fc.speaker: Runa
a9ab3bf298fc.text: Bow's still good. So am I.

4be15bcea6e9.speaker: Runa
4be15bcea6e9.text: I counted our steps to the exit. I'd rather not count that close again.

22bb3b638e13.speaker: Runa
22bb3b638e13.text: I've tracked things my whole life, and never one that big. It left nothing behind but quie

4ecbbe66d0c6.speaker: Runa
4ecbbe66d0c6.text: The forest doesn't hate us. It doesn't notice us. That's worse. Next time I pick the way.

ac8498391449.speaker: Runa
ac8498391449.text: You crossed open ground to reach me. Stupid. Don't stop.

82f25a4f97a4.speaker: Runa
82f25a4f97a4.text: I've watched you for two days. You leave a trail like a cart.

83ddfdab46db.speaker: Runa
83ddfdab46db.text: I see them. Take the near ones.

2e7baa813e90.speaker: Runa
2e7baa813e90.text: That's all of them. I think.

54116c754e87.speaker: Runa
54116c754e87.text: A bow! Then there are two of us. Hold the left button to draw, let go to shoot. It wants b

fc45b90fe661.speaker: Runa
fc45b90fe661.text: An honest answer. I like you already.

58db53990606.speaker: Runa
58db53990606.text: Down! Moss trolls in the bushes, the small kind. Don't let them get behind you!

17f7d42bc191.speaker: Runa
17f7d42bc191.text: It followed us! The old one, coming through the trees, right for the stones!

8a27c131194d.speaker: Runa
8a27c131194d.text: It hasn't seen us yet. It will smell the smoke soon enough.

328df4ed422f.speaker: Runa
328df4ed422f.text: Off the road, on your left! Rootlings. They were lying in wait, and they don't do that.

b00d7059f538.speaker: Runa
b00d7059f538.text: Runa. I find the tracks, and I shoot what makes them. Trolls off their crags, witches on t

be8e32bc3a0b.speaker: Runa
be8e32bc3a0b.text: Simple. I respect that. Hit it until it stops, and it leaves you a hand free.

887555d0ecff.speaker: Runa
887555d0ecff.text: Small ones never come alone and never come this far down. Something up in the high woods i

c31becc1faf5.speaker: Runa
c31becc1faf5.text: A shepherd told me his dogs won't go past the tree line any more. Dogs. I have seen those

6220934ca767.speaker: Runa
6220934ca767.text: Boar, running flat out, and not from us. Off the road!

03b14bc0c556.speaker: Runa
03b14bc0c556.text: Hold up. That's Bjarne's handcart, tipped off the road. Have a look; I'll watch the trees.

bcb862eb293e.speaker: Runa
bcb862eb293e.text: No birds. Have you noticed? Not one for a while now.

dcf1a7e7f7bc.speaker: Runa
dcf1a7e7f7bc.text: Sigrid. Look behind us. Where is the road? It was right there, and now there's only mist.

79762cc1733a.speaker: Runa
79762cc1733a.text: Still think the coin is worth it?

81fe60ce0409.speaker: Runa
81fe60ce0409.text: The shadows are wrong. They were behind us when we crossed the stream.

f079ef1436aa.speaker: Runa
f079ef1436aa.text: There. Feel that? The wind turned, and there is mist coming up off the moss.

cc5dc71a6d5b.speaker: Runa
cc5dc71a6d5b.text: Wolves behind them! In the open, in daylight. They don't do that. Weapons!

e7adde700087.speaker: Runa
e7adde700087.text: You shot straight this morning. It may matter before the night is out.

416711decc01.speaker: Runa
416711decc01.text: Your grandmother never saw wolves walk into a lit camp.

7ab773db310c.speaker: Sigrid
7ab773db310c.text: Thank you. I thought that was it.

1435ba85f835.speaker: Sigrid
1435ba85f835.text: I can't take much more of this.

8025809c9a81.speaker: Sigrid
8025809c9a81.text: Nothing gets to you without going through me.

053ff52b89af.speaker: Sigrid
053ff52b89af.text: Because the only old things out there are stones and roots, and the marks on them are olde

0418ea8f8156.speaker: Sigrid
0418ea8f8156.text: Eirik sees a great deal for a man who pretends not to. Yes. I have seen stones like these

8793c7c39e0b.speaker: Sigrid
8793c7c39e0b.text: I know what it feels like: a door left open in winter. Someone opened it on purpose. Wheth

52c2d1d575e7.speaker: Sigrid
52c2d1d575e7.text: Ingrid, Bjarne, Tor and Liv. An alchemist, a smith, a carpenter and a scholar: the ones wh

53cd9f2912e6.speaker: Sigrid
53cd9f2912e6.text: The cause. Trolls do not leave their crags for no reason, and wolves do not forget fire. S

44633b210fe7.speaker: Sigrid
44633b210fe7.text: They did not send me. They asked for someone who could read the old marks, and I was the o

c53623d73d20.speaker: Sigrid
c53623d73d20.text: Words for things your tongue has no names for. Most of them mean wait. One of them means o

fd961fae27d8.speaker: Sigrid
fd961fae27d8.text: The villages think we came for wolves and witches. Let them. The stones out here are older

76203d72bee1.speaker: Sigrid
76203d72bee1.text: Keep the torch high and the road under your feet. The forest is listening tonight. Let it

2e44675fdddf.speaker: Sigrid
2e44675fdddf.text: Take what time you need, but not too much. It is a long walk, and I want to be at the fore

ec9cbef506e6.speaker: Sigrid
ec9cbef506e6.text: Stand inside the ring. Whatever you see, do not let go of the stone until I say.

59bb2faac379.speaker: Sigrid
59bb2faac379.text: Dry stone overhead. Good work. Now a fire, before anyone can think clearly: eight sticks a

37b5ff1bb70c.speaker: Sigrid
37b5ff1bb70c.text: That was no weather. The sun went down hours early and this storm came out of a clear sky.

6ec4a4d98c7d.speaker: Sigrid
6ec4a4d98c7d.text: The packs are tied and the fire is nearly out. Ingrid's party should have been back yester

4c2744958650.speaker: Sigrid
4c2744958650.text: The stones are drawing power! Hold them off until the connection forms!

1c36832f26b2.speaker: Sigrid
1c36832f26b2.text: There you are. Come and stand by the fire with the rest of us. You should know who you are

0879fdb649d0.speaker: Sigrid
0879fdb649d0.text: Hold together! Nobody gets left behind. We will find each other, whatever happens.

f7d6413d0e2a.speaker: Sigrid
f7d6413d0e2a.text: Finish your porridge and listen. This is the only quiet you will get today.

b940fd324d01.speaker: Sigrid
b940fd324d01.text: Stay on the road. We keep a steady pace, and the others will wait if you fall behind.

1d4032fe69b3.speaker: Sigrid
1d4032fe69b3.text: Seven went in. Tell me who's home.

6f337bd93c06.speaker: Sigrid
6f337bd93c06.text: Don't you stop for me. That's an order.

44a6dc3f243c.speaker: Sigrid
44a6dc3f243c.text: Good. On your feet. I mean, on mine.

7ee8dc1bcfc1.speaker: Sigrid
7ee8dc1bcfc1.text: A retreat is only a defeat if you learn nothing. What did we learn?

9528ca031d18.speaker: Sigrid
9528ca031d18.text: I gave you an order once to leave me if it came to that. You didn't. We'll talk about disc

394e637562bc.speaker: Sigrid
394e637562bc.text: I've buried good people on less than what we just did. Write it down somewhere. It should

52d7287f9b34.speaker: Sigrid
52d7287f9b34.text: I've served under worse than you. Don't let it go to your head.

b706dbb4a24b.speaker: Sigrid
b706dbb4a24b.text: You came back. I told them you would.

869a001ac1cc.speaker: Sigrid
869a001ac1cc.text: ...can anyone hear... Ingrid was right behind me when the stones broke. She's hurt. Find h

efd49b01c1b8.speaker: Sigrid
efd49b01c1b8.text: A fire. Sit down, all of you, and get your breath back. Whatever is out there will still b

e51b80c5623c.speaker: Sigrid
e51b80c5623c.text: Almost! Hold it off, just a little longer!

5144aa4ce4f3.speaker: Sigrid
5144aa4ce4f3.text: At first light we find the four who went ahead. Ingrid. Bjarne. Tor. And...

d2ef296b3fd8.speaker: Sigrid
d2ef296b3fd8.text: Careful. The ones who go looking for the truth of it are the ones who find it.

7761ac604c16.speaker: Sigrid
7761ac604c16.text: For anyone who slept through last night's talk, and I know who you are: I am Sigrid, and w

8f8c51a7519c.speaker: Sigrid
8f8c51a7519c.text: It will not wake for me. It never has. You, then. Put your hand on the centre stone.
